name: @semantic-release/npm
description: Stands in for @semantic-release/npm, which semantic-release depends on but this repository never loads: release.config.cjs names its plugins, so the default list that holds it is not used. The real package bundles the npm CLI and with it http-cache-semantics, which has an advisory with no fixed release (GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp).
